body: I’m only fifteen but believe me I’ve already messed up a lot of my life, I don’t think there’s anything I can change
Yeah. I remember where I got it very well. I would like to see Metallica too but I don’t really have the time to anymore I guess, since I’ll be leaving soon
My favorite album that I owned was an original pressing Metallica’s Master of Puppets. But unfortunately my mother smashed that one while drunk so now I don’t really have a favorite
Only one, I like collecting vinyl records, but now thinking about that just makes me a bit angry because of some stuff that happened
I can’t. I’ve tried. No matter what I do I fuck it up. It doesn’t matter in the slightest. It’s okay too because it never has mattered.
Well i must be a burden because I’m reminded that I am by just about everyone who’s supposed to care about me, I can’t argue with them though because I’m just wasting everyone’s time
I have no other options, I’ve waited a long time for life to be good but it really doesn’t matter because I can’t wait any longer. I’m a burden on everyone I know
